p = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u003/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ae0fa3a6.py')
source = '''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 0 and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            components.append(comp)
    comp = max(components, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in comp)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in comp)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in comp)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in comp)
    src = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    sh, sw = len(src), len(src[0])
    out = [[0] * sh for _ in range(sw)]
    for r in range(sh):
        for c in range(sw):
            out[sw - 1 - c][sh - 1 - r] = src[r][c]
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(source)
